# TDrive v3.0.3

This release fixes the iPhone downloader runtime, improves mobile layouts and navigation, brings AI settings and photo-library uploads to mobile, and adds verified desktop updates that install on the next launch.

**Tiếng Việt:** Bản này sửa lỗi downloader trên iPhone, căn chỉnh lại giao diện và đường quay về Account, thêm chọn ảnh/video từ thư viện và cấu hình AI trên điện thoại. Desktop có biểu tượng cập nhật cạnh nút AI, tự tải bản cập nhật đã xác minh và cài khi mở lại ứng dụng. Có đủ gói Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS và Android trong Assets bên dưới.

## Highlights

- **Desktop updates:** an update button between Search and AI shows availability, download progress and readiness. Verified downloads install on the next app launch.
- **iOS downloader:** fixes “The downloader is not installed in this build” by including and linking the complete embedded Python runtime, native modules and HTTPS certificate bundle.
- **Mobile AI:** access the AI assistant from the mobile header and configure providers, models and API keys from **Account > AI Models**.
- **Photo-library uploads:** choose photos and videos directly from the iPhone or Android library, alongside the existing file picker.
- **Mobile polish:** correct drive names, cleaner focus and selection styles, improved landscape video controls, a usable downloader sheet, and consistent Back navigation.

## Desktop updates

- Windows, macOS and Linux gain a toolbar update indicator and keep their Updates settings.
- Automatic downloading is enabled by default and can be disabled in settings. Automatic downloads wait when a file transfer is active.
- Downloaded updates are scheduled for the next launch. Settings also offers immediate installation and restart.
- TDrive authenticates the signed checksum manifest and checks the downloaded payload before installation. Pending updates are verified again at startup.
- Microsoft Store-managed Windows installations continue to use the Store update path. The GitHub desktop updater requires a supported installation in a writable location.

## iPhone and Android fixes

- The Files header shows the selected drive name, such as **My Drive**, instead of always showing **TDrive**.
- Remove the overlapping focus rectangles on the drive title and prevent the selected drive row from clipping at the sheet edges.
- Keep the video player's More button beside Close with consistent spacing in portrait and landscape.
- Give **Download from link** a visible Back button, responsive fields and a single scrolling area. Quality options and setup text no longer have separate clipped scroll areas.
- Add **Photo library** to the upload menu. On iPhone this uses the native photo picker; existing **Upload files** and folder actions remain available.
- Show the TDrive logo and the actual app version in **About**.
- Add padding around **Wi-Fi only** and **Only while charging** in photo/video backup settings.
- Back from photo/video backup returns to **Account**. Back from **Trash** returns to the tab that opened it: Account or Files.
- Make **AI Models** fit phone widths: reduce the left inset and title spacing, let the description use the full width, and place **Add model** below it.
- Store mobile AI credentials using iOS Keychain and Android Keystore. Android bridge debug logs no longer print argument payloads containing API keys.
- Add **Account > App updates** to mobile for release checks and installation guidance. Mobile updates still follow the operating system's installation flow.

## iOS downloader repair

Earlier iOS packages contained yt-dlp's Python files but omitted the linked Python framework and complete standard library. The setup button could not repair that package on the phone.

This release bundles CPython 3.13, yt-dlp, the native standard-library extension frameworks and certifi's CA certificates. Both Taskfile and Xcode builds use the same packaging path. The iOS engine ships inside the IPA; setup only confirms that it is ready. Updating the bundled yt-dlp requires a new TDrive app build.

The native Simulator check imports Python/SSL/yt-dlp, validates the CA store, downloads a local MP4 through yt-dlp and checks its SHA-256 against the original. This verifies the embedded runtime and a real download, not every supported website or physical-device configuration.

## Downloads and installation

| Platform | Asset | Installation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `TDrive-v3.0.3-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Run the per-user installer. |
| Windows x64 portable | `TDrive-v3.0.3-windows-amd64.zip` | Extract the entire ZIP and keep the `media` folder beside `TDrive.exe`. |
| Linux x64 | `TDrive-v3.0.3-x86_64.AppImage` | Mark executable, then launch. Requires glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| macOS Apple silicon | `TDrive-v3.0.3-macos-arm64.zip` | Extract and move TDrive.app to Applications. The app is not notarized; use macOS's Open confirmation if prompted. |
| iPhone/iPad arm64 | `TDrive-v3.0.3-ios-unsigned.ipa` | iOS 16 or newer. Sideload and sign using your installation tool; this is not an App Store or TestFlight build. |
| Android arm64 | `TDrive-v3.0.3-android-arm64.apk` | Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. Install the APK and confirm the Android installation prompt. Signed with this fork's release key. |

CLI archives for Windows, Linux and macOS and a source archive are also included. The Windows and Linux desktop builds are x64; the macOS desktop build is Apple silicon arm64.

## Upgrade notes and limits

- Existing installations from this fork should use the same installation/signing method when upgrading. An upstream-signed Android APK cannot be updated in place using this fork's different release key.
- Desktop automatic installation on the next launch is implemented in v3.0.3 and applies to subsequent updates. Mobile does not silently replace the installed app: Android requires installation confirmation, and sideloaded iOS requires the user's sideloading tool.
- The iOS build does not include ffmpeg. Formats that require merging separate audio/video streams or conversion are unavailable; choose a combined format.
- Keep the phone app open while link downloads or the first large photo backup finish. This release does not add unrestricted background execution.
- Automatic desktop installation of yt-dlp and ffmpeg remains Windows-only. On macOS and Linux, install those tools separately and make them available on PATH.
- Simulator and browser checks do not replace testing on a physical iPhone or Android device. Shared-drive roles still need broader testing with multiple live Telegram accounts.
- Do not downgrade to v2.x after using v3.x on the same account: older builds cannot read the readable captions written by v3.x.

## Integrity and verification

- `checksums.txt` lists SHA-256 digests for the downloadable packages.
- `checksums.txt.sig` authenticates that manifest for the desktop updater using the embedded Ed25519 trust keys.
- Android release certificate SHA-256: `A8:F4:4A:72:E0:56:E1:79:DE:19:4C:F3:E3:10:84:9D:5C:B6:BA:5A:58:EC:5F:A6:AD:BA:DD:29:FB:DC:22:92`.
- Automated verification covers frontend typecheck, lint, unit tests and coverage, browser/WebKit contracts, Go tests and race checks, platform builds, Linux AppImage startup, Android signing/package metadata, and the native iOS downloader check.
